_README: The watchlist. This file is now the whole point of the tool: it scans eBay for PSA 10 autographs of these men and nothing else. Adding a player here adds an eBay search for him on the very next run. Removing one stops it.
_howItWorks: Every player listed gets his own eBay query every scan, so a new listing is found within one cycle rather than waiting for a rotation. Only PSA 10 autographs asking under alert.reasons.target.maxAskUsd are emailed, and each listing is emailed once.

_scale.1.0: no opinion, default for everyone not listed

_alwaysAlert: True means every listing of that man is emailed once, whatever the tool thinks of the price. That is the only reason anything gets emailed now. Set it false to keep a player in the scan without the notifications.
_note: conviction orders the email, it does not decide what is in it. Primaries sort above secondaries.
_2026rookies: No cards exist yet. Add each name here as the class is drafted and their autos start printing; one row is all it takes and the scan picks it up on the next run.
